target_customer: Makers and operators of off-highway and industrial vehicles (agriculture, mining, ports, yards, defense) that want autonomy without building a robotics team
problem: Automating an industrial vehicle normally needs a full in-house robotics stack. Polymath sells a hardware-agnostic autonomy layer controlled through a REST API.
business_model: Software licenses and retrofit autonomy programs for vehicle fleets, with a free simulation tool (Caladan) as top of funnel

founders.name: Stefan Seltz-Axmacher
founders.background_notes: Founded and led Starsky Robotics per TechCrunch July 2022. Education not found in an opened source.

founders.name: Ilia Baranov
founders.background_notes: Led robotics teams at Clearpath Robotics and Amazon Lab 126 per TechCrunch July 2022.

competitors.name: Outrider
competitors.what: Autonomy kit that turns electric yard trucks into autonomous vehicles for distribution yards
competitors.traction_then: Released a next-generation autonomy kit in July 2022
competitors.funding_then: Press describes a $53M Series A at its launch (date not verified)

technical_complexity.rationale: General autonomy across vehicle types with safety behavior and teleoperation fallback is hard for a small team, though limited to closed industrial sites in 2022.

defensibility.rationale: Early product relied on software integration and partner drive-by-wire kits; no network effects or exclusive data were evident in 2022 sources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of an incumbent copying or buying Polymath. The company remained independent per sources found.

market_need_then: In 2022 TechCrunch described customers in agriculture and industrial sites wanting autonomy without a robotics team, and the founder said they were already driving unmanned and talking to potential customers.

branding.domain_note: Uses polymathrobotics.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Casual, with taglines like Let's get automated and Superpowering off-highway autonomy programs

branding.brand_signature: Caladan, the free browser-based simulator, and the Automate It podcast
branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch coverage described a reporter driving a tractor in California from Arizona through a browser. Company runs a podcast and social channels.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand itself; recognition comes from the founder's Starsky history and the launch demo.

outcome_analysis: Polymath is still operating per the YC page. It launched in July 2022 with a small angel seed and a demo that drew press, helped by a founder with prior autonomous trucking experience. No later priced rounds or exits were found, so its trajectory beyond early traction is unknown.
notes: Aggregators disagree on total raised: CB Insights says $500K, Extruct says $120K; both unverified and not recorded as rounds. A search also surfaced a different company called Polymath (a kids maths app); ignored. Ilia Baranov education is reported as UWaterloo in a search snippet only; not recorded. Searches found no acquisition or layoff news.
